regime.label: Put-rich protection book at 56 DTE, riding a local long-gamma shelf at 1080
evidence: +1,665 baht/pt net GEX at the 1080 ATM strike - the largest of the last 9 sessions - built on 2,170 call OI against 889 put OI; this local shelf has held the future inside 1067.6-1096.6 for nine sessions.

1110 gamma flip still sits 27.8 points above spot 1082.2, and cumulative net GEX is negative from 910 through 1100, troughing at -3,611 baht/pt at 1070 - below 1070 dealer hedging amplifies instead of fades.

27,770 put OI against 15,131 call OI (P/C 1.84), with the 910 strike alone holding 10,056 contracts - 36% of all put OI - at 22.75% IV, 8.65 vols over the 14.10% ATM. That is insurance pricing, not a directional vote.
Both wings added OI while the near-money thinned vs 2026-07-28: puts +460 at 1020, +369 at 910, -423 at 1080; calls +279 at 1150, +156 at 1120, -202 at 1060.

S50U26.today_summary: 1082.2 on the future sits 22.2 points above the 1060 max pain, which has not moved in six of the last seven sessions. Net GEX totals +3,124 baht/pt with +1,665 of it concentrated at the 1080 ATM strike, but the cumulative flip is at 1110, so the long-gamma cushion is local rather than structural. P/C OI at 1.84 against P/C volume at 0.97 says the put book is standing hedge, not today's flow. ATM IV 14.10% implies a 9.61-point 1-sigma day, 0.89% of index.
what_changed: ATM-strike GEX flipped from -150 baht/pt on 2026-07-31 to +1,518 on 08-01 and +1,665 today, as 423 puts closed at the 1080 strike.
Put OI rolled lower and further out vs 2026-07-28: +460 at 1020, +110 at 1010, +369 at 910, against -423 at 1080.
Call OI stacked higher: +279 at 1150, +156 at 1120, +155 at 1140, while 1060 and 1070 shed 290 contracts combined.
25-delta skew compressed to +0.60 vol from +3.26 on 2026-07-14, the flattest near-money in three weeks, even as 910-strike put IV rose to 22.75% from 19.81%.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Net GEX has expanded 2.6x from +1,224 baht/pt on 2026-07-23 to +3,124 today while the gamma flip walked down from 1120 to 1110, tightening the dealer-stabilised band around the 1080 call wall. The 2026-07-31 session is the mechanism proving itself: the future broke to 1067.6, ATM GEX went negative at -150 baht/pt, and the day printed -16.2 points - 1.7x the 9.50-point 1-sigma - then snapped back +16.3 the next session once 1080 was regained. Max pain has held 1060 for six of seven sessions and neither the 1080 call wall nor the 910 put wall has migrated in nine, so the structure is anchoring rather than trending. What is genuinely moving is the wings: 10,056 contracts now sit at the 910 put, up from 9,687 five sessions ago and 1,999 at series inception, at 22.75% IV versus 19.26% in June. On Vol2Vol that tail reads live by volume, OI and IV - 150 lots traded today and its OI has never fallen - but it is 172 points, 15.9%, below spot, so it prices crash risk without exerting any current hedging pull.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1060 / 1020
strategies.rationale: The neutral-gamma Protection row of the matrix calls for cheap defined-risk downside insurance: 1060 is both max pain and the top of the 1000-1070 band where cumulative GEX is negative and dealer hedging amplifies, while the +0.60 25-delta skew makes near-money puts the cheapest relative to calls since 2026-07-14.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 8.0 points net debit (1060 put ask 14.9 less 1020 put bid 6.9). Spread is 40 points wide, breakeven 1052.0, max value 32.0 points below 1020.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1090 with ATM GEX holding above +1,500 baht/pt - the long-gamma shelf reasserts and the hedge bleeds theta.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1110 / 1130
strategies.rationale: Sells above the 1,723-contract 1100 call wall and into the +1,224 and +635 baht/pt long-gamma stack at 1110 and 1130, where dealers sell rallies rather than chase them; at 14.10% ATM IV with 56 days left the 5.0-point credit is a decay position, not a directional call.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 points width less 5.0 points credit (1110 bid 12.1, 1130 ask 7.1) = 15.0 points. Breakeven 1115.0.
strategies.invalidation: A close above the 1115.0 breakeven, or 1110 call OI expanding past 1,700 on continued 200-plus lot volume - 233 lots traded there today, the heaviest single-strike call flow in the chain, which would mean the wall is being bought through.

strategies.name: Financed hedge: 1060/1020 put debit against 1110/1130 call credit
strategies.rationale: Pays for the downside insurance with upside the 1100-1150 call stack is already capping (1,723 + 1,371 + 845 + 680 + 897 OI, all positive GEX), mirroring what the book itself did over five sessions - puts rolled down to 1020 and 910, calls stacked up to 1120 and 1150.
strategies.defined_risk: Net debit 3.0 points. Max loss 3.0 points if settled between 1060 and 1110; max loss 23.0 points if settled above 1130 (20-point call-spread loss plus the 3.0 debit); max gain 37.0 points below 1020.
strategies.invalidation: A close above the 1110 gamma flip - the financing leg becomes the dominant risk and the structure stops being a hedge.

S50U26.prediction: 1070-1100 containment is the base case while the +1,665 baht/pt long-gamma shelf at 1080 holds, with 1060 max pain as the downside magnet and the 1,723-contract 1100 call wall as the cap. A sustained break below 1070 enters the -3,611 baht/pt cumulative-GEX trough where dealer hedging amplifies the move, opening 1040 (25-delta put) and then 1010 (10-delta put) - that level, not max pain, is the invalidation for any range view. Upside invalidation is a close above the 1110 gamma flip on rising call volume.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks; treat the 1060 max pain and the 1080 shelf as tendencies, not guarantees. At 56 DTE the option structure is loose and macro or news flow can override it outright. Defined-risk is not risk-free: the 8.0, 15.0 and 23.0-point maximum losses above are real and do occur. The max-pain failure pattern is not currently triggered - spot is 2.1% from max pain with IV flat at 14.10% and expiry far away - but it becomes the operative read if price runs from the structure on expanding volume and IV near expiry.
